mapper.sql: d.id, CASE UPPER(d.dispense_enum) WHEN 'RETURN' THEN '退药' WHEN 'REFUND' THEN '退药' ELSE '发药' END AS dispense_type_name, CASE UPPER(d.status_enum) WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'DONE' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN '处理中' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' ELSE d.status_enum END AS dispense_status_name, r.prescription_no, p.name AS patient_name, e.bus_no AS inpatient_no, stay.ward_name, stay.bed_no, m.name AS drug_name, m.total_volume AS spec, COALESCE(d.dispense_quantity, d.quantity) AS dispense_quantity, d.unit_code, d.lot_number, d.trace_no, COALESCE(practitioner.name, preparer.name) AS pharmacist_name, d.dispense_time

FROM med_medication_dispense d INNER JOIN adm_encounter e ON e.id = d.encounter_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN adm_patient p ON p.id = d.patient_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_request r ON r.id = d.med_req_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition m ON m.id = d.medication_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner preparer ON preparer.id = d.preparer_id AND preparer.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner practitioner ON practitioner.id = d.practitioner_id AND practitioner.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked_el.encounter_id, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(ranked_el.form_enum) = 'BED' THEN location.name END) AS bed_no, COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(ranked_el.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN location.name END), MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(parent.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN parent.name END), MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(grandparent.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN grandparent.name END) ) AS ward_name, COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(ranked_el.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN location.id END), MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(parent.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN parent.id END), MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(grandparent.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN grandparent.id END) ) AS ward_id FROM ( SELECT el.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY el.encounter_id, UPPER(el.form_enum) ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(el.status_enum) = 'ACTIVE' AND el.end_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, el.start_time DESC, el.created_at DESC, el.id DESC ) AS position_rank FROM adm_encounter_location el WHERE el.is_deleted = 0 AND UPPER(el.form_enum) IN ('WARD', 'BED') ) ranked_el INNER JOIN adm_location location ON location.id = ranked_el.location_id AND location.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_location parent ON parent.id = location.parent_id AND parent.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_location grandparent ON grandparent.id = parent.parent_id AND grandparent.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ranked_el.position_rank = 1 GROUP BY ranked_el.encounter_id ) stay ON stay.encounter_id = e.id
